3Write a How much or How many question for each answer. Ask about the quantity.

  1. 1

    There are three apples on the middle shelf.

  2. 2

    There are four eggs in the open tray.

  3. 3

    There is one jug of milk on the top shelf.

  4. 4

    There are two carrots beside the eggs.

  5. 5

    There is one bowl of yoghurt in the fridge.

  6. 6

    We need two cups of flour to make the pancakes.

  7. 7

    Add one tablespoon of olive oil to the sauce.

  8. 8

    We need three tomatoes for the fresh salad.

  9. 9

    Use half a glass of milk for the mixture.

  10. 10

    There are two oranges beside the apples.

  11. 11

    There is one cucumber in the bottom compartment.

  12. 12

    We need a pinch of salt for the dip.

  13. 13

    There are five pieces of fruit on the middle shelf.

  14. 14

    Use two cloves of garlic in the yoghurt sauce.

  15. 15

    We need a little butter to grease the baking tray.
